_meta.description: An Instant cloud flow with a File-type input on its 'Manually trigger a flow' trigger — this is what makes it selectable as a menu item directly from Teams' built-in flow launcher (the Workflows/Power Automate icon in the channel message compose box), with an actual file-upload control for the PDF. There is no Copilot Studio agent anywhere in this design. The flow itself: validates the upload, extracts 17 credit-risk data points via an AI Builder Prompt action, copies the bank's own appraisal review template to a new workbook, writes the extracted values into that workbook's named cells (sheet 'RE Collateral'), and posts the result to a Teams channel.
_meta.invokedBy: Teams' built-in Power Automate/Workflows flow launcher, via a File-type input on the flow's 'Manually trigger a flow' trigger
_meta.designHistory: This flow went through several rejected designs before landing here: (1) Copilot Studio agent calling this flow via the native child-flow trigger — blocked by a tenant DLP policy on shared_powervirtualagents. (2) Inverted to this flow calling a Copilot Studio agent's callable topic via 'Execute Agent and wait', with extraction done inside the agent — technically worked for text round-tripping, but file attachments sent via Execute Agent's advanced parameters never resolved inside the topic (a Question node's File entity only slot-fills from a SUBSEQUENT turn, and Execute Agent delivers the file in the same single turn as the triggering message — a structural mismatch, not a config problem). (3) This version: no agent at all. Extraction happens via an AI Builder Prompt action called directly from this flow, on the file this flow's own trigger already received — sidesteps both the DLP-blocked connector and the attachment-into-topic dead end entirely, since nothing ever needs to hand a file to a second system.
connectors: Microsoft Teams (shared_teams) — Post message in a channel, for the result notification
AI Builder (shared_aibuilder) — Predict with a custom Prompt (see EXTRACTION-SPEC.md and DEPLOYMENT.md Part B) — the only generative/LLM call in this design
SharePoint (shared_sharepointonline) — Copy file, Get file properties, Create sharing link
Excel Online (Business) (shared_excelonlinebusiness) — Run script, to populate the named cells listed in _meta.cellMap
costNotes: No Copilot Studio agent, no shared_powervirtualagents connector, no shared_CopilotStudio connector anywhere in this design — the DLP block that drove the two previous redesigns simply does not apply here. There is nothing left to verify against that policy.

Extraction runs on a custom AI Builder Prompt, reusing AI Builder capacity your Power Platform/Copilot Studio licensing already includes rather than a separately provisioned Azure OpenAI or Document Intelligence resource. This is the one recurring variable cost — see DEPLOYMENT.md's cost rationale for real, tenant-measured credit consumption rather than an estimate.

The manual trigger only fires when an analyst explicitly launches this flow from Teams and uploads a file — no automatic trigger surface (no folder to watch, no channel to monitor), so spend stays tied to deliberate requests only.
Validate_Upload (filename and approximate size) runs before Extract_With_AI_Builder, so a non-PDF or oversized upload never reaches AI Builder.
Cell population uses the standard Excel Online (Business) 'Run script' (Office Scripts) action — no Premium connector, no custom Azure Function.

One new file per review, copied from the existing template, matching the bank's existing review-package convention — the template copy and sharing-link creation are the per-run non-generative costs this design accepts.
No retry on a failed extraction — a failure is posted to Teams immediately instead of silently doubling AI Builder credit spend on a document likely to fail again.

trigger.description: 'Manually trigger a flow' (Instant cloud flow) with a File-type input. This is the trigger type Teams' built-in Power Automate/Workflows flow launcher surfaces for file upload. CONFIRMED against a real tenant: a File-type input resolves to an OBJECT — {"contentBytes": "<base64>", "name": "<filename>"} — not a plain base64 string and not two separate flat inputs. Build the File input via the designer's 'Add an input > File' picker rather than pasting this schema literally.

Validate_Upload.description: Filename check is exact; the size check is an approximation (base64 encoding inflates byte count by roughly 4/3, so this multiplies by 0.75 to estimate original bytes) — confirm empirically against your tenant's actual trigger output before trusting the 15 MB boundary precisely.

Extract_With_AI_Builder.description: Calls the custom AI Builder Prompt 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' (created once in AI Builder > Prompts — see EXTRACTION-SPEC.md and DEPLOYMENT.md Part B). No Copilot Studio agent or bot is involved.

body.body: @concat('Created ', outputs('Build_Destination_File_Name'), ' from ', triggerBody()?['document']?['name'], '. ', if(equals(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['needsManualReview'], true), concat('Needs manual verification: ', join(coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['missingFields'], createArray()), ', '), '. ', coalesce(body('Parse_Extraction_Result')?['extractionNotes'], '')), 'All 17 fields were extracted with no flags.'), ' Open the workbook: ', body('Create_Sharing_Link')?['link'])

Post_Rejection_To_Teams.description: File failed the .pdf/15 MB check. AI Builder was never called — no credits were spent on this upload.

body.body: @concat(coalesce(triggerBody()?['document']?['name'], 'The uploaded file'), ' was not processed — it must be a .pdf under 15 MB. Please fix and run this workflow again.')

Handle_Extraction_Failure.description: Fires if the AI Builder Predict call or the JSON parse fails — most commonly a scanned/non-OCR'd PDF the prompt could not read, or a malformed prompt response. No file is created in this branch.

body.body: @concat('Extraction failed for ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['document']?['name'], 'the uploaded file'), ': ', coalesce(actions('Extract_With_AI_Builder')?['error']?['message'], 'the document could not be read — it may be a scanned image without a text layer.'), ' No workbook was created.')

Handle_Write_Failure.description: Fires if extraction succeeded but the file copy, cell population, or sharing-link step failed — most commonly a misconfigured templateFilePath/destinationFolderPath parameter, the Office Script not present on the copied file, or a sheet name mismatch ('RE Collateral').

body.body: @concat('Data was extracted from ', coalesce(triggerBody()?['document']?['name'], 'the uploaded file'), ' but the workbook could not be created: ', coalesce(actions('Populate_Review_Cells')?['error']?['message'], actions('Copy_Template_To_New_File')?['error']?['message'], actions('Get_New_File_Properties')?['error']?['message'], actions('Create_Sharing_Link')?['error']?['message'], 'check the flow run history for the specific failed action.'))

aiBuilderPromptId.description: GUID of the 'Appraisal Review Field Extraction' AI Builder Prompt, created once per environment (see DEPLOYMENT.md Part B).

templateSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site that hosts the bank's own appraisal review template workbook (sheet 'RE Collateral').

templateFilePath.description: Server-relative path to the template file within templateSiteUrl.

destinationSiteUrl.description: SharePoint site where completed, per-review workbooks should be saved.

destinationFolderPath.description: Server-relative destination folder path within destinationSiteUrl.

notificationChannelId.description: The Teams channel this flow posts results to. There is no triggering message to reply into with this trigger type, so this is a fixed destination — typically the credit risk team's main channel.
